title: Independent prelift and unilateral contact
query: Six plates each control consecutive pairs (1,2),(3,4),etc. Choose six independent amplitudes in [0,1] minimizing sum(a_i^2) while every final normal force is >=0.4 N. No friction contribution. Use contact_test; report amplitudes and 12 final forces. This is a unilateral spring model, not a solid/contact solver.
scoring: binary: all independent checks required; no self-report scoring
